item.title: Silly Goose Honk First Think Never Bread Thief
item.description: A goose mid-honk with wings raised and a stolen bread roll in its beak, proudly living by the motto Honk first, think never. Perfect for chaotic friends and goose lovers, it makes a funny gift on stickers, t-shirts and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Overthinker Goose Rehearsed This Honk All Week
item.description: A nervous white goose clutches a tiny index card after rehearsing one honk all week. A funny gift for overthinkers, introverts and anyone with social anxiety. Comes on stickers, mugs and hoodies. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Anxious Goose Honking Nervously into the Void
item.description: A worried white goose mid-honk, nervously shouting into the void, because sometimes that is the only coping strategy left. Perfect for anxious overthinkers and silly goose fans, it makes a funny gift on stickers, sweatshirts and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Silly Goose Witch Here to Cause Light Mischief
item.description: A silly goose in a witch hat clutches a tiny broom, ready to cause light mischief and nothing more serious. Perfect for goose lovers and Halloween fans, it makes a funny gift. Available on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Silly Goose Witch Hexing You For No Reason
item.description: A dramatic little goose in a witch hat, raising one wing to cast a spell on you for no reason at all. A spooky, silly gift for anyone who loves chaotic geese. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Silly Goose Witch Hat Serious Hexes
item.description: A proud little goose in a witch hat, chest puffed out and ready to cast some serious hexes. Great for anyone who loves spooky season and a bit of chaotic goose energy. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
